title: Fröhlicher Landmann (The Happy Farmer), Op. 68 No. 10
subtitle: from Album für die Jugend (Album for the Young) - complete, Frisch und munter
trains: A famous bouncy tune shared between the hands - the opening melody sits in the left hand under offbeat right-hand chords, then the hands trade roles for a running middle section with brief two-voice moments in the right hand - independent eighth-note coordination at a lively tempo.

provenance.author: Musicanyya practice material
provenance.basedOn: Robert Schumann, Album für die Jugend Op. 68 No. 10 "Fröhlicher Landmann" (1848, public domain). Complete piece, from the Mutopia Project edition schumann-op68-10-gai-laboureur. Pitches/rhythms extracted programmatically from Mutopia's rendered MIDI, cross-checked against the .ly source.
provenance.note: Marking is "Frisch und munter" (fresh and lively) - confirmed independently, not "Nicht schnell" (that is Op. 68 No. 13). Source MIDI tempo (quarter=100) used unchanged, within this level's cap. Pitch class 10 spelled as diatonic B-flat (F major, no accidental); the source's two B-natural accidentals kept. Meets Intermediate caps: span 31 semitones, longest eighth-note run 9 (cap 32), density ~4.6/~6.5 notes/s (caps 6/12), 2 voices in the right hand (cap 2).
